segments.name: Men's wellness telemedicine
segments.description: Connects consumers to licensed healthcare professionals via telehealth and markets men's wellness products including ED, hair loss, hormone and weight loss treatments.
segments.evidence: We also focus on developing, marketing, and selling a variety of men's wellness products and services via a telemedicine platform.

revenueModel.text: Consumers pay the company for compounded men's wellness products ordered through its telemedicine platform and fulfilled by a compounding pharmacy.
revenueModel.evidence: All Compounded Products are produced at and fulfilled by Epiq Scripts, LLC (" Epiq Scripts "), a related party compounding pharmacy, 52% owned by Jacob Cohen, our Chief Executive Officer and Chairman, and are available to patients on the determination of a prescribing physician that the compounded drug is necessary for the individual patient.

changes.text: In 2025 the Company entered into and then rescinded a Master Distribution Agreement with Navy Wharf for Diabetinol, cancelling the related shares.
changes.evidence: On July 30, 2025, the Company entered into a Mutual Rescission and Release Agreement (a " Rescission Agreement ") with Navy Wharf, pursuant to which the Company and Navy Wharf agreed to terminate and rescind the Navy Wharf Agreement, effective as of July 30, 2025
